data.name: Hurayah
data.gender_notes: Hurayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-r-y, Hurayah refers to freedom, liberation and liberty. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Anfal, Verse 46, when Allah (SWT) grants the believers the freedom to fight against their enemies. Thus, Hurayah signifies the spirit of courage, bravery and resistance in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and resistance in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Hurayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freedom, Liberty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hurayah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
